note: Bytes copied verbatim from aukora-membrane minimal/ at commit d8b17fac and never edited. The same minimal/verify.py bytes are pinned in Deep c417f7c5. Retaining this tree at all is the pin: scripts/phase0-check-pins.py recomputes every sha256 and byte length below and refuses on any drift, extra sibling or missing file. minimal/replicas/ (a Rust third implementation together with its target/ build output) is deliberately NOT vendored; nothing in this tree imports it. minimal/tour.py is vendored as the upstream teaching artifact and is not run by CI: it reports its own unimplemented paths as MISSING!! when the rest of the membrane tree is absent, and it decides no verdicts itself, because it shells out to verify.py.

genesisAuthored.why: Genesis-authored run sheet and limit statement. Not upstream bytes, so pinning it as upstream would be a false provenance claim. Listed here so the checker can require it by name rather than ignore the whole directory.
This manifest. A file cannot carry its own digest; the checker prints the manifest digest on every run instead.

Genesis-authored, derived from aukora-toy vendor/phase0/vectors/same_size_ok.json (MIT) by translating its retained/presented pair into this court's wire shape. The toy's own vectors are in a different shape and its court takes different arguments, so they cannot be used here unchanged — see scripts/phase0/README.md. This case is the no-growth path: retained size == presented size with an equal root. Every other vector here grows the log, so this class had no coverage at all.

Genesis-authored, derived the same way from the toy's same_size_fork.json: same size, presented root differing in the last nibble. Decides OBSERVATION_CONFLICT / same_size_root_mismatch, which is the only shape in which a fork with no growth is provable at all.

files.note: *** THIS ONE FILE DEPARTS FROM UPSTREAM BYTES, AND THIS IS WHY. *** Upstream `minimal/` @ d8b17fac carried a 4,674-byte PARAPHRASE of the AGPL-3.0 that was not the licence: it omitted section 13 (Remote Network Interaction) entirely, its numbering restarted at 2 and 3 so sections 4-13 were absent and two pairs of numbers collided, and it nonetheless carried the FSF's own notice that changing the document is not allowed. A verified outside audit found it. THE PIN NOW RECORDS THE VERBATIM AGPL-3.0 TEXT -- byte-identical to this repository's root LICENSE -- because a licence file that is not the licence grants nothing and, worse, reads as though it does. Upstream's bytes are NOT preserved here, deliberately and for this reason alone.
